The '''Cybloc Transfer Station''', also known as the '''InterGalactic storehouse station''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the orbit of [[Cybloc]]. The station was under the control of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. It was [[Raid on the Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|attacked]] by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].
